public_payload.normalized_proposition: If OpenAI and Anthropic make the planned token price cuts, they would be deadly to the AI industry.
conditions: if OpenAI and Anthropic make the planned price cuts

statement.excerpt: I cannot express how deadly these price cuts would be to the AI industry, and how dangerous this conversation has become.

our_interpretation: Read the condition as substantial token-price reductions by both OpenAI and Anthropic following the contemplated June price competition.
Read 'deadly' as widespread business failure or lasting destruction of financial viability among AI model providers. Lower prices or narrower margins alone do not meet that standard.
No deadline is supplied. Later model-specific cuts establish that both companies cut token prices, but do not prove that the exact June proposals were implemented unchanged.
criteria.support_condition: Both companies implement substantial token-price cuts, followed by widespread insolvencies, closures, or lasting loss of financial viability attributable to those cuts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence conclusively establishes that the relevant cuts were absorbed while the affected industry achieved durable financial viability. A few months of continued operation cannot conclusively refute an undated prediction.
